pages.text: Facades can be used to make your base appear more clean. They can cover up both sizes of cable, and be made out of many kinds of blocks.$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)They can cover all sides of a cable, but will let $(l:ae2_mechanics/cable_subparts)subparts$(/l) and cable connections protrude though.

$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)Be clever with them to improve your base aesthetic or make blocks with different textures on each side.$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()

pages.title: Hiding Facades
pages.text: Facades will be hidden while holding a $(l:items_blocks_machines/network_tool)network tool$(/l) in either hand.$(br2)You can interact with blocks behind hidden facades without having to remove the facades first.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: Place the block you want the texture of in the middle of 4 $(l:items_blocks_machines/cable_anchor)Cable Anchor$(/l)s.
